description: Diff a before/after JSON write for deletes, null-vs-omit and emptied arrays against protected paths — Compares the JSON document an agent read (before) with the one it is about to write (after) and lists every change by JSON Pointer: removed members, null turned into omitted (and the reverse), arrays emptied or shrunk, objects emptied, type changes. Fails when a change touches a protected path or is destructive and not listed in allowDestructive; use it before a PUT, PATCH or bulk update. Arrays a

after.description: JSON value about to be written.

allowDestructive.description: JSON Pointers ("*" wildcard) under which deletes, emptied containers and type changes are intended.

protectedPaths.description: JSON Pointers that must not change at all; a "*" token matches any one key or index.

name: mutation-intent
